name: willdeep-video-studio
description: Turn ideas and reference frames into locally tracked asynchronous AI video jobs, with an optional WillDeep chat model acting as the creative director.

interface.shortDescription: AI 视频工坊：用聊天模型策划镜头，再通过可替换的视频 Provider 异步生成、跟踪并下载视频。
interface.longDescription: Use WillDeep chat and multimodal review models to plan, generate and review short-drama video shots. Track asynchronous jobs locally, inspect timestamped frame sheets, and block episode composition when a selected shot fails visual review.
defaultPrompt: 把这个创意整理成镜头并生成短视频
使用一张首帧参考图生成视频
查看正在生成的视频任务
